_comment: Hand-curated layer of docs/capabilities.json. Built by stapel_analytics/_capabilities.py over stapel_tools.surface.build_static_capabilities (no OpenAPI triad yet, so no operations): axis key/kind/default are read from conf.DEFAULTS for _capabilities.AXES and only the prose below is curated; the surface entry set is derived from surface_roots by AST, and a selected symbol without an intent line fails `make contract`.
provides: The backend half of the analytics standard: an ingest endpoint for @stapel/analytics batches with an event registry and a PII guard, server-side track() for modules, a comm bridge from business Actions, funnels and event reports over the core event store, adapter fan-out, last-touch click attribution, offline click-conversion upload, and GDPR erasure of the event stream.

REGISTRY_MODE.summary: What happens to an event name the registry does not declare: warn (store it and mark it, the default), reject (refuse the batch) or off.

REQUIRE_WRITE_KEY.business_label: Only keyed sources may send events
REQUIRE_WRITE_KEY.summary: Off by default. On: an ingest batch without a recognised write key is refused with 401, so only configured sources can write analytics.

PII_MODE.summary: Ships reject: a property value that looks like personal data refuses the event. strip removes the value, warn stores it and logs, off disables the guard.

RETENTION_DAYS.summary: Days an analytics event is kept before the purge drops it (400 by default); None keeps events forever, which a deployment states rather than drifts into.

FANOUT_ENABLED.summary: On by default: recorded events are announced as analytics.events.recorded and delivered to the configured adapters. Off: events are stored only.

extension_points.name: EVENTS
extension_points.summary: The event vocabulary this deployment admits ({name: definition | None}, merged over EVENTS_FILE and runtime register_event()); None removes an entry.

extension_points.name: ADAPTERS
extension_points.summary: Fan-out targets for recorded events ({name: spec | None}, merged over the built-ins and runtime register_adapter()).

extension_points.name: COMM_BRIDGE
extension_points.summary: {action_name: event_name | spec}: turn a business comm Action (payment.completed, ...) into an analytics event without code in the emitting module.

extension_points.name: PII_GUARD
extension_points.summary: The PII heuristic callable(value) -> bool, same contract as the frontend guard. Never read from the environment.

extension_points.name: SUBJECT_RESOLVER
extension_points.summary: Which id a funnel groups one event row by (user hash, else anonymous id, else session id). Never read from the environment.

extension_points.name: INGEST_AUTHENTICATION
extension_points.summary: Authenticator classes for the ingest view only.

check_write_key.intent: Resolve an ingest body's source from its write key, refusing an unrecognised key when REQUIRE_WRITE_KEY is on — the gate a custom ingest path calls before recording.

record_batch.intent: Record one ingest body (registry check, PII guard, clock correction) and return the receipt; the single write path behind POST /events.

track.intent: Record ONE server-side event from a module — the in-process twin of the analytics.track Function, so a server funnel step lands in the same stream as the browser's.

validate_steps.intent: Refuse a funnel whose steps can never be reached before it is saved.

save_funnel.intent: Create or update a funnel row after validating the whole rule; the write path the API and a project's seed share.

delete_funnel.intent: Delete an authored funnel (declared ones are refused by the view).

purge_events.intent: Drop analytics events past the retention horizon and return how many — what the purge task and command run.

looks_like_pii.intent: The default PII heuristic for one value (swappable through PII_GUARD); reuse it rather than writing a second guard that disagrees.

pii_mode.intent: The effective PII_MODE (reject|strip|warn|off) — read it through this, not the setting.

guard_props.intent: Apply the PII mode to an event's props: return them cleaned, or raise in reject mode. Every path that stores props goes through it.

hash_user_id.intent: The subject key of a person (sha256 of salt + user id) — the same key the frontend facade computes, so funnels join and erasure finds the rows.

requires.reason: the event store the events live in, the comm bus (Functions, the bridge, fan-out Actions), GDPR owner registration, AppSettings, JWT auth and the error envelope
